one_line: One photo becomes a one-take trailer: rush, crash in, rise, crash in again, pull back wide, title.
custom_stage: no new graph for shots: reuses vertigo + crash_zoom + levitate + the Pull Back clip; SG Bridge (workflows/bridge.api.json) generates the transitions; SGTitleCard lays the title

defaults.cut: one continuous take: match cuts only on identical framing, otherwise generated bridges; no dissolves, no fades, no fade to black (LAW-7, LAW-9)

shots.name: crash_zoom
shots.label: Crash Zoom (whip in to the face, native speed)

bridge_in.note: LTX bridge from the vertigo settle cut internally; a 5-frame zoom whip reads as one move

shots.name: levitate
shots.label: Levitate (crash out to wide, rise to the apex)

shots.name: face
shots.label: Face beat (generated crash in from the apex)

bridge_in.prompt: The shot continues in one unbroken take, no cut: the camera rushes forward fast and crash-zooms into a close-up of his face while he floats down, same man, same canyon, same light; a man with long dark wavy hair under a black baseball cap, his two eyes glowing bright gold, glowing translucent circuit-lit forearms and hands, wearing a black t-shirt printed with the bold words DEITCH BEATS DON'T QUIT between two red mushrooms and gold circuit lines, in a red sandstone canyon with floating golden sparks. Both eyes stay brightly lit, face sharp and unchanged, shirt text crisp and legible, photoreal, cinematic

shots.name: pull_back
shots.label: Pull Back (generated crash out into the pillars, 4x pull-back)

bridge_in.prompt: The shot continues in one unbroken take, no cut: the camera pulls back fast from the close-up of his face to a wide shot, revealing him standing between tall twisted red sandstone pillars in hazy desert light; a man with long dark wavy hair under a black baseball cap, his two eyes glowing bright gold, glowing translucent circuit-lit forearms and hands, wearing a black t-shirt printed with the bold words DEITCH BEATS DON'T QUIT between two red mushrooms and gold circuit lines, in a red sandstone canyon with floating golden sparks. Both eyes stay brightly lit, face sharp and unchanged, shirt text crisp and legible, photoreal, cinematic

title_card.title: OPEN SAUCE
title_card.subtitle: A LIGHTBRUSH PRESET
title_card.note: rides the last 1.8 s of the Pull Back shot (no held frame); fully opaque from its first frame, letters slam in from 1.35x over 6 frames; poster = the wide canyon frame

version: v7 (one take: SG Bridge between shots, title slams in over the Pull Back; the experimental orbit shot was removed)
input_requirements: face clearly visible, head not touching the frame edge
9:16 (1088x1920 finals; shots and bridges must share one size)
known_issues: reused shots keep their own sub-recipes only as ids in extra.shots; the trailer recipe's api_workflow is the cut plan (+ bridge settings), not a ComfyUI graph
bridges hold ~0.6 s on the start frame, then whip in ~6-8 frames (LTX-2.5 first/last-frame behaviour); the face close-up beat appears twice (crash in, then generated crash in from the apex)

LTX bridges cannot cross a perspective change (eye-level -> aerial) or a same-scale world swap: they dissolve or hard-cut; the Earth fly's two aerial hand-offs are whip-tilts (scripts/earth_fly_1080.py), not generated
Earth fly at 1080 is the 704x1280 chain upscaled (lanczos): its segment-B graph was never recorded
bridges add ~4.8 s: total ~16 s although the shot plan is ~11.5 s

2026-10-17: the experimental face->orbit "earth_fly" shot was removed from the trailer; it was built with end-image guides that dissolve, which the one-take rule forbids. The take now ends on the Pull Back.

bridges.note: per boundary: mean abs diff of A's last vs B's first frame < match_threshold -> match cut, else a bridge of bridge_in.frames (8k+1) rendered at the shots' size and cached by frame hash in outputs/trailer/bridges/; its first/last frames are dropped and the rest plays unretimed
